text:
incident-bot: PAGING: runtime-canary rollout_v2 in prod-us-west1 exceeded latency/error thresholds; auto-escalating to oncall.

oncall-ash: I'm on it, joining logs now. seeing a spike in p95 and kernel_fallback_count on canary machines.

sre-lina: confirming -> kernel_fallbacks up from 0.2% to 6.8% after deploy. batcher queue depth skyrocketed

eng-raj: deployed canary at 2026-03-15T19:45Z, rollout_v2 enabled. I can attempt a quick rollback if needed.

ops-simon: recommend flip feature flag first to reduce new traffic to v2: /usr/local/bin/ff-toggle --env prod --flag rollout_v2 --state off

oncall-ash: executing flag flip now...

oncall-ash: (run) curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" -d "flag=rollout_v2&state=off" --silent

sre-lina: seeing traffic drop to v2 within 30s, but existing sessions still hitting KV cache paths with mismatched kernels, causing tail latency.

eng-raj: starting canary rollback: deployctl rollback --deployment canary-2026-03-15-19 --timeout 10m

incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV2 — degradation in latency and errors; affected endpoints: /generate, /embed.

pm-sam: Support report: ~12 customer accounts impacted, transient 500s on long-sequence generations. Notifying account teams.

support-alex: Posting to customer-status channel and tagging impacted customers, will provide ETA once rollback done.

ops-simon: If rollback doesn't stabilize within 10m, flip to fallback-model-route to serve a compatible quantized variant: /routes/set --route embed=quant-v1

oncall-ash: rollback finished, p95 back to baseline for most nodes. kernel_fallback_count dropping.

sre-lina: monitoring; current error rate at 0.9% (pre-incident baseline 0.6%). continuing 30m watch. :thumbsup:

eng-raj: adding postmortem task: investigate kernel selector logic regression when batcher inflight > 200.

pm-sam: I'll coordinate customer communication and severity update.

oncall-ash: Handoff to next oncall @sre-lina in 45m for cooldown monitoring. Leaving runbook notes and commands executed above.

sre-lina: Acknowledged. please attach logs + deploy meta to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0315-42

eng-raj: quick note: tentatively root cause = kernel selector heuristics + new batching threshold introduced in rollout_v2. Will test patch in staging.

support-alex: customers updated. closing alert once stable for 1h.

oncall-ash: Thanks team. :rotating_light: Follow-ups: postmortem, test-case for preflight kernel selector, and adding a safety cutoff in the feature toggle to auto-cut traffic if kernel_fallback > 1%.
